transcript.statement: The requirements I propose focus on ensuring the RollCall system operates with optimal performance efficiency. EFF-01 guarantees real-time processing for immediate attendance updates, while EFF-02 ensures the system can handle at least 500 concurrent users without degradation. EFF-03 provides timely report generation for up to 1000 students, and EFF-04 aligns with historical data retention while optimizing storage. EFF-05 allows students to quickly view their attendance records, and EFF-06 optimizes resource utilization through load balancing. Finally, EFF-07 ensures a responsive user interface, crucial for user satisfaction. Together, these requirements prioritize performance and user experience.

transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent emphasizes the need for robust security and privacy measures in the RollCall system. TRU-01 ensures encryption of attendance data to protect sensitive information, while TRU-02 implements role-based access control to restrict data access based on user roles, preventing unauthorized access. TRU-03 maintains an audit log for all modifications, supporting accountability. TRU-04 allows students to view their records only after authentication, safeguarding their data. TRU-05 ensures data integrity through checksums, and TRU-06 provides a mechanism for reporting breaches. TRU-07 enforces session timeouts to prevent unauthorized access during inactivity. Together, these requirements establish a secure and trustworthy environment for handling attendance data.

transcript.statement: The SafetyAgent emphasizes the critical need for safety and reliability in the RollCall system. SAF-01 ensures secure authentication, preventing unauthorized access to sensitive attendance data. SAF-02 provides real-time data synchronization, ensuring accurate attendance records across classes. SAF-03 implements alerts for discrepancies, promoting data accuracy. SAF-04 mandates historical data retention for long-term analysis while SAF-05 supports accountability through logging attendance modifications. SAF-06 allows manual overrides during failures, enhancing fault tolerance, and SAF-07 ensures continuous security audits to identify vulnerabilities. Together, these requirements establish a robust safety framework for the system.

transcript.statement: The ResponsibilityAgent emphasizes the importance of ethical compliance and accountability in the RollCall system. RES-01 ensures compliance with data protection regulations like GDPR, safeguarding student privacy. RES-02 promotes transparency by logging attendance changes, supporting accountability. RES-03 allows students to dispute records, ensuring fairness in attendance management. RES-04 guarantees anonymization in reports for privacy protection. RES-05 notifies students of their attendance status, fostering responsibility. RES-06 implements role-based access control, ensuring only authorized personnel access sensitive data. RES-07 maintains historical data for compliance with educational regulations. Together, these requirements establish a framework for ethical responsibility and compliance.
